Name: Abednego
Summary: Abednego (KJV: Abed-nego) was the Babylonian name given to Azariah, one of Daniel's three companions; he was set over the affairs of the province of Babylon and, with Shadrach and Meshach, refused the golden image and walked out of the fiery furnace unharmed. ONE profile covers both names; he is a different man from Azariah son of Hoshaiah.
KeyStory: Abednego was bound and cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace with his two friends, and the king saw four men walking loose in the fire, unhurt.
LifeLesson: God is present in the fire, not only after it — the fourth man walks in the midst of it.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
